note: One accepted outside-connection query-model publication as a typed evidence study, referenced from Road, Ship and Air. It is not pooled with the native outside-v1/v2 studies, it is not a promise or a certificate, and no research code runs as a product check.

outside-query-model-v1.title: Query-scoped outside-connection reachability model
outside-query-model-v1.scope: One retrospective, query-scoped question on the accepted outside-v1 native study and its targeted repeat: given one literal-boundary outside-connection request, does the native pathfinder return a complete path whose first and last positions equal the requested offsets? The model reads only the saved pre-query network. The observations already existed before this model; nothing here is prospective, blind or a new capture.
outside-query-model-v1.method: The accepted study classified 876 retained road, ship and air native path rows and scored the 378 literal boundary requests among them against a frozen family of 12 reachability rules per mode, with lane:any_lane:forbidden registered as primary and a leave-one-package-out selection over the six packages that carry a primary request. A read-only bridge re-derived every field the model reads from the nine unchanged .crp packages. This ledger re-checks the archived bytes, re-derives every table from the preserved request rows and refuses a changed binding. No scorer, predictor or native run is repeated.
outside-query-model-v1.limits: Retrospective and query-scoped on one observed cohort: not blind or global accuracy, not a random sample of geography, and not geographic impossibility of any mode. A selected request failure labels only that exact query under that exact protocol; it never establishes that a place cannot support a road, harbour or airport, that a service exists, or that a player will see one. The 19 road false positives all sit in two targeted second openings, all return flags=8 and length=100000, and all remain unexplained: a retained sentinel is not proof that a search budget was exhausted. Chord length is not a native cost, grade, width, water depth or SI conversion, and no native threshold was fitted. Ship and air retain one class only, so their arithmetic precision of 1 carries no information and no rule can be distinguished on them. Midpoint repeats, direction pairs and repeated openings of one package are correlated, not independent votes, so no confidence interval treats requests as independent packages. The nine packages are curated squares read-only by SHA-256; 114 collector-recipe-only observations and 264 runtime-bound observations stay separate and are not a strict no-mods or memory attestation. Three openings failed before a network snapshot existed and stay recorded as anomalies. No observation date is recorded anywhere in the publication, so every observation date stays Unknown rather than being replaced by a publication or freeze time. The study does not transfer this evidence's agreement to the current runtime checker, the live estimate, a certificate, a promise or rail.

protocol.scope: retrospective, query-scoped reachability over the retained road, ship and air native path requests of the accepted outside-v1 study. Not prospective and not blind: these observations already existed.
protocol.positive_label: complete and released native path whose returned first and last positions equal the requested literal offsets
protocol.negative_label: complete and released selected request whose native result reports success=false; an observed failure for that exact request, mode, flags and protocol, never a geographic negative
protocol.unknown_label: incomplete, unreleased or endpoint-mismatched result; unscored
protocol.protocol_copied_from_source: PathManager.CreatePath; vehicle per mode (Car/Ship/Plane), category PassengerCar for road / All for ship and air; laneTypes Vehicle for road / Vehicle|TransportVehicle|CargoVehicle for ship and air; seed 857, maxLength 100000, literal [segment,lane,offset] endpoints.
protocol.features_allowed: pre-query network topology: segment id, start/end node ids, prefab, endpoint positions, segment Invert, and per-lane index, lane type, vehicle, category and recorded direction.
protocol.features_forbidden: place names, artifact ids, special segment ids, query outcomes, returned paths, panel counts, observation bytes, old scores, the request's own endpoint_roles/endpoint_edges/lane_directions metadata.

collector_source.note: Exact source hash in retained build receipts, also identical at original outside-v1 publication.

domain.junction: all: every incident mode segment pair connects at a node. The retained queries are two-endpoint reachability questions and do not separate junction-pairing hypotheses, so those are not searched.
domain.length_measure: sum of segment chord lengths, a lower bound on the native curve length; a path whose lower bound exceeds maxLength is not a success.
domain.segment_flags: `Invert` is applied: travel away from a node counts as forward only when (node == segment start) XOR Invert.

pairings.any_lane: every mode lane continues onto every mode lane at a node
pairings.index_mirror: lane ordinal i continues onto ordinal n-1-i
pairings.index_same: lane ordinal i continues onto ordinal i
pairings.orientation_index: i at a mixed node, n-1-i at a same-sided node
pairings.orientation_mirror: n-1-i at a mixed node, i at a same-sided node

uturns.allowed: a vehicle may reverse inside a node
uturns.forbidden: a vehicle never reverses inside a node

protocol.primary_rule_basis: registered before scoring: the weakest lane-continuation hypothesis (any lane continues onto any lane) with no reversal, matching the protocol's mode-specific lane types and category mask.
protocol.selection_criterion: leave-one-package-out: on the remaining packages maximise F1, break ties by higher recall, then by the frozen rule order. Reported as retrospective selection, not as a fitted law.

strata.midpoint_diagnostic: not scored; correlated repeat of a boundary request
strata.primary_distinct_edge: scored primary stratum, distinct map edges
strata.same_edge: scored separately, both endpoints on one map edge

runtime.note: Old CPU and reproduction receipts bind each package and each opening to its retained build; they are the publication's own lineage, not a fresh native re-hash.

length_check.note: Undirected lower bounds alone cannot prove cap insensitivity. All successful directed paths remain below the cap with 20% longer chords; all no-path predictions remain disconnected without a cap.

air.note: one class only: the retained evidence for this mode contains successful requests and no observed failures. The arithmetic precision is therefore trivially 1 and no discrimination among the frozen rules is estimable.

ship.note: one class only: the retained evidence for this mode contains successful requests and no observed failures. The arithmetic precision is therefore trivially 1 and no discrimination among the frozen rules is estimable.

bridge.question: Can every field the model reads be recovered from the saved .crp bytes plus a fixed captured prefab/lane catalog?
limitations: The lane templates are captured from the same native snapshots the model was fitted on; they are a fixed catalog, not an independent read of the game's prefab assets.
Node OneWayIn/OneWayOut flags are recomputed by the game at load; only the Outside bit is used by this study's eligibility stratum, and it agrees on every node.

Segment endpoint positions are compared with a 0.5 m tolerance. Airplane-path and some movable segments differ beyond it because the snapshot records the segment's own endpoints while the save stores node centres; 99.80% of segments still have a chord length within 2% and 100.00% within 20%. The model uses chord length only in the protocol's maxLength lower-bound check, and `evaluation.json` reports that no eligible query comes within 60% of the cap, so this difference cannot change a prediction.

eligibility_rules.midpoint_diagnostic: offset 128 diagnostic; never scored, its boundary sibling is the correlated repeat
eligibility_rules.mode_lane_absent_at_endpoint: endpoint segment carries no lane of the mode's vehicle
eligibility_rules.not_a_literal_boundary_request: endpoint not at 0/255, not at an Outside node, same node or same segment
eligibility_rules.primary_distinct_edge: literal boundary request (offsets 0/255 at two distinct Outside nodes on two segments), ends on different map edges, complete and released native response
eligibility_rules.requested_source_lane_absent: the request names a lane the endpoint segment does not have
eligibility_rules.requested_target_lane_absent: the request names a lane the endpoint segment does not have
eligibility_rules.same_edge: same literal boundary test, both ends on one map edge
eligibility_rules.unclassified_protocol: earliest collector version: no position_kind or rail field; unknown, not scored
